claim_boundary: Recomputes per-term partial derivatives of retained native scalar updates. It runs no decoder, adds no experiment and carries no performance evidence.

objective.check_term: g_{c,i} = -(2 w_par/n) r_c prod_{j in c, j != i} x_j, with r_c = 1 - prod_{j in c} x_j
objective.coordinates: one scalar per bit; x_i = +1 favours bit 0 (bit-0-positive)
objective.formula: J(x) = -(w_ch/(2n)) sum_i ell_i x_i + (w_par/n) sum_c (1 - prod_{j in c} x_j)^2 + (w_bin/n) sum_i (1 - x_i^2)^2
objective.update: x <- clip(x - eta grad J / D, -1, 1), eta = step_size * 0.5^backtrack, accepted at the first strict decrease of J
